citation: Powell et al. 2020. Sotagliflozin decreases postprandial glucose and insulin concentrations by delaying intestinal glucose absorption. J Clin Endocrinol Metab 105:e1235.
protocol: Mixed-meal tolerance test after a single oral dose of placebo, sotagliflozin 400 mg or canagliflozin 300 mg: drink with 75 g glucose, boiled egg 70 g, mozzarella 70 g (50% kcal carbohydrate); dual glucose tracer; RaO sampled 0-5 h. Breakfast at 0.25 h post-dose (cohort 1) or lunch at 4.25 or 5.25 h (cohorts 1 and 2).
population: 24 healthy participants in two cohorts of 12. Cohort 1 mean age 37.1 (SD 11.6) y; cohort 2 mean age 43.3 (SD 9.2) y; 22 male; BMI 29.7 (SD 4.2) and 29.5 (SD 2.8) kg/m2.

reports.marker: rate of appearance of oral glucose (RaO), AUC 0-1, 0-2, 2-5 and 0-5 h, mg/kg FFM
plasma glucose AUC and incremental AUC

note: Group values are geometric least-square means; the 90% CIs are for ratios against placebo only, so per-arm dispersion is not printed. Use the placebo arm as the healthy meal reference; the drug arms are the study's question. Cohorts differ in timing after dose.
